module: Flowgraph node "Rally Loop Save Attempt" (category once_instant, tag rally). Records the rally loop attempt. With dnfType set ("restart" or "abandon"), creates a DNF attempt via RallyAttempts.createRallyLoopAttemptForDnf (unless the current mission is 'serviceOut', not counted). Without dnfType, creates the finish attempt (createRallyLoopAttemptForFinish) and outputs: change (change object) and outroTranslation ({txt = end text, context = copy of attempt.data}), the text coming from RallyLoopStars.getOutroText or otherwise from missionTypeData.endScreenText.

workOnce.desc: Creates the DNF or finish attempt and fills the outputs change and outroTranslation (finish case only).
